searchText: Latest article up on the validator lifecycle: https://www.attestant.io/posts/understanding-the-validator-lifecycle/ Thanks for the article! I have a question but I’m not sure if this is the correct location to ask: will validators in the future be able to withdraw funds without exiting? Or will the only way to obtain the funds is by exiting? +1 Should be. As validator accumulate gains, those gains should be allowed to be taken out for other purposes.
